papers.title_en: Deploying RDMA for Distributed Inference and Training At Scale
papers.authors: Yibo Huang, Yi Cui, Yukai Huang, Huaping Zhou, Jiancong Tong, Zhaoyu Wu, Gen Miao, Haoran Wei, Boyan Ding, Zhuo Jiang, Jianxi Ye, Yibo Zhu, Chuanxiong Guo, Yang Xu, Jie Wu
papers.evidence: 面向分布式训练与推理的生产级RDMA通信层
papers.tldr: 大规模分布式推理与训练虽可借助RDMA降低通信开销，但变长消息、并发连接、突发汇聚流量及故障恢复使“替换TCP”远远不够。字节跳动部署ByteExpress，在应用与传输层协同管理缓冲区、连接和未完成数据，并以RPC实现上层恢复。生产推理中参数拉取平均与P99延迟分别下降35.7%和43.7%，CPU降低10.69%；训练中P99参数推送延迟最高下降74.0%，且未出现PFC暂停。工作说明RDMA规模化落地依赖端到端软件机制而非单纯硬件卸载。
papers.abstract_en: RDMA can reduce communication overhead in distributed machine learning systems, but realizing these benefits in production requires more than replacing TCP. Variable-size messages, concurrent connections, bursty incasts, and service failures introduce challenges that hardware offload alone cannot address. This paper reports our experience deploying ByteExpress, a software communication layer over hardware RDMA, in ByteDance's parameter-server-based inference and training systems. We present three lessons from the deployment: efficient RDMA requires buffer management across application and transport layers; scalable communication requires coordinated management of connections, receive capacity, and outstanding data; and service availability requires recovery above the transport layer. ByteExpress combines an RDMA-aware allocator, zero-copy transfers, QP multiplexing, receive-credit flow control, a software send window, and RPC-assisted recovery. In production inference, ByteExpress reduces mean and P99 model parameter fetch latency by 35.7% and 43.7%, respectively, and total CPU usage by 10.69% compared with kernel TCP. In training, ByteExpress reduces P99 model parameter push latency by up to 74.0% compared with TCP, with no PFC pauses observed at runtime.

papers.title_en: Accelerating MoE Training through Expert Placement and Replica Coordination
papers.authors: Zhiqiang Tan, Maoxin Wang, Wenxiang Lin, Sijie Wang, Qiang Wang, Shaohuai Shi, Bo Li
papers.evidence: 面向分布式MoE训练的专家放置与副本协同优化
papers.tldr: 稀疏激活MoE分布式训练受动态路由引发的负载失衡和全互连通信制约，分层去重后的通信语义又与逐令牌—专家计算负载不同。PlaceMoE联合优化专家物理布局与按源设备感知的令牌副本映射，并显式建模分层通信和计算代价。其求解器结合共选感知分组、受限动态规划副本分配及交替细化，并将副本梯度同步与注意力反向传播重叠。在32卡GPU和64卡NPU上，相比VeOmni，通信最高加速6.94倍、端到端训练加速1.74至2.33倍，说明协同放置与副本协调可显著提升MoE训练效率。
papers.abstract_en: Distributed training of sparsely activated mixture-of-experts (MoE) models is often bottlenecked by workload imbalance and all-to-all (A2A) communication induced by dynamic token routing. Existing token deduplication, expert placement, and replication techniques alleviate these bottlenecks but do not jointly capture their distinct load semantics. Under hierarchical token deduplication, communication counts each token once per destination group at each hierarchy level, whereas expert computation processes every token-expert assignment. With replication, both costs depend jointly on physical layout and token-to-copy mapping, making separate optimization suboptimal. We present PlaceMoE to address this coupling. First, we formulate the joint optimization of expert layout and source-aware token-to-copy mapping for E experts distributed across P devices, accounting for both hierarchical communication traffic and expert-compute load. Second, we develop a solver that combines co-selection-aware expert grouping, bounded dynamic programming for replica allocation, and alternating refinement of layout and mapping. Third, PlaceMoE overlaps replica-gradient synchronization with attention backward. We evaluate PlaceMoE on a 32-GPU cluster and a 64-NPU cluster using Qwen3-VL and DeepSeek-V3. Experimental results show that PlaceMoE achieves up to a 6.94x speedup in A2A communication and 1.74-2.33x speedups in end-to-end training over the state-of-the-art training framework VeOmni.

papers.title_en: BSIPipe: Bidirectional Sequence-Level Interleaved Pipeline Parallelism for Long-Sequence Large Language Model Training
papers.authors: Yuzhou Ni, Ling Chen
papers.evidence: 用于大模型训练的双向交错流水线并行
papers.tldr: 长序列大模型训练常依赖序列级流水并行，但现有方案按子序列单向调度，吞吐受流水气泡和调度限制。BSIPipe在子序列级协同两条方向相反的V形交错流水线，并以基本单元拼接将激活存储控制为不随子序列数增长。结合拓扑感知映射、通信计算重叠及张量并行，方法规避死锁并缓解双向内存开销。在GPT与LLaMA3上，相对最先进序列级基线平均提速1.11至1.13倍，为长上下文训练提供更高效的并行路径。
papers.abstract_en: Pipeline parallelism has become a critical technique for training large language models. To address the throughput limitation of existing sequence-level methods that schedule subsequences unidirectionally, we propose bidirectional sequence-level interleaved pipeline parallelism (BSIPipe), which co-schedules two opposing V-shaped interleaved pipelines at the subsequence level. To bound the activation accumulation from subsequence scaling, BSIPipe introduces a basic-unit concatenation mechanism that keeps activation memory invariant to the subsequence count. To eliminate communication deadlock risk from bidirectional scheduling, BSIPipe employs a communication optimization strategy that combines topology-aware device mapping with communication-computation overlap. In addition, BSIPipe composes with tensor parallelism to overcome the memory limitation of single-dimensional parallelism, neutralizing its bidirectional memory overhead while maintaining throughput. Experiments on GPT and LLaMA3 demonstrate that BSIPipe achieves average speedups of 1.11$\times$ to 1.13$\times$ in long-sequence training over SOTA sequence-level baselines.

papers.title_en: DualColl: Throughput-Optimal Bandwidth-Bound Collective Communications via Fractional Tree Packing
papers.authors: Namir Ballan, Reuven Cohen
papers.evidence: 面向大规模GPU分布式训练的高吞吐AllReduce
papers.tldr: 大规模分布式训练中的全规约常受异构互连带宽限制，现有方案通常将其拆分为全收集与规约分散，难以直接优化端到端吞吐。DualColl将全规约建模为分数树打包，利用乘法权重迭代搜索高吞吐树集合。其精确树代价预言机把物理链路对偶价格映射到逻辑秩图，通过最短路与最小生成树高效求解。该方法以可证明近最优保证扩展树式全规约调度，并适配喷洒路由、隐式带宽共享及多组并发通信。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale distributed training increasingly makes collective communication bandwidth-bound. In modern GPU clusters, communication libraries such as NCCL implement collectives including AllReduce over heterogeneous interconnects such as NVLink, InfiniBand, and Ethernet, making efficient use of available network bandwidth a central systems challenge.   ForestColl showed that collective communication on such fabrics can be formulated using fractional tree packing; its scalable polynomial-time construction is developed for AllGather, with AllReduce obtained by composing AllGather and ReduceScatter. We present DualColl, which targets bandwidth-bound AllReduce directly. Under the tree-based AllReduce model, DualColl applies a Garg--Könemann-style multiplicative-weights algorithm and, for any $0<ε<1$, computes a feasible schedule whose throughput is at least $(1-ε)^2$ of the optimal AllReduce throughput. Its key component is an exact minimum-cost collective-tree oracle that projects physical-link dual prices onto a logical graph of participating ranks, reducing each iteration to shortest-path computations followed by a minimum spanning tree.   We further extend the framework to local equal-next-hop packet-sprayed routing and to networks without explicit per-tree bandwidth control. For the latter, we introduce a tree-coupled max-min bandwidth-sharing model and show that tree duplication approximates an explicit fractional allocation with a provable accuracy-complexity tradeoff. Finally, we extend the fractional-packing framework to additional collective operations and multiple concurrent collective groups.

papers.title_en: MCCL: Measurement-based Collective Communication Library
papers.authors: Michele Ferrero, Gabriele Castellano, Paolo Medagliani, Sebastien Martin, Roberto Morabito, Massimo Gallo
papers.evidence: 面向分布式GPU训练的自适应集合通信
papers.tldr: 大规模分布式训练中的集合通信常依赖按静态拓扑和峰值带宽预计算的开放式调度，但持续性的灰度故障会悄然降低链路吞吐与时延表现，使既有调度长期失效。MCCL将运行时被动测量、退化检测与动态调度重综合形成闭环，并可在不中断训练的情况下热切换新调度。原型实验显示其额外开销低于2%、测量误差低于1.2%、切换约12毫秒；仿真中面对灰度故障，训练时间较静态调度最高缩短4.99倍。该工作为生产集群适应网络性能漂移提供了实用的通信运行时机制。
papers.abstract_en: Collective communication is a critical performance bottleneck in large-scale distributed training. Existing libraries and synthesis frameworks compute open-loop schedules once, assuming a static topology and peak link capacities. In production, however, persistent gray failures can silently degrade link throughput and latency for hours, causing pre-computed schedules to lose much of their efficiency during execution. In this paper, we present Measurement-based Collective Communication Library (MCCL), a collective communication library that closes the loop between runtime network measurement and dynamic schedule synthesis. MCCL passively measures GPU-to-GPU throughput, detects persistent degradation, re-synthesizes the affected communication-intensive schedules with warm-started synthesizers, and hot-swaps them without interrupting training. We validate the complete loop on a multi-node hardware prototype and use simulations to evaluate cluster-scale scenarios. In our experiments, MCCL incurs negligible overhead (<2%) while maintaining high measurement accuracy (<1.2% error) and low schedule hot-swap time (about 12 ms). Notably, under gray failures, MCCL reduces training time by up to 4.99x over static schedules on simulated training workloads for state-of-the-art LLMs such as Llama and DeepSeek.

papers.title_en: Simulate Before You Scale: High-Fidelity LLM Inference Planning Without GPUs
papers.authors: Dipanwita Guhathakurta, Mert Toslali, Srinivasan Parthasarathy, Jing Chen, Michael Kalantar, Nicholas A. Masluk, Vishakha Ramani, Asser Tantawi, Fabio Oliveira
papers.evidence: 面向GPU集群推理的调度、路由与并行规划
papers.tldr: 大规模LLM推理的硬件、并行、路由与准入决策相互耦合，直接在GPU集群反复试验成本高，现有预测工具又难刻画批处理和排队动态。BLIS以CPU离散事件仿真覆盖准入、调度、预填充与解码、KV缓存及抢占，并用全局拟合的解析延迟模型估计执行时间。36项实验中其中位端到端误差为6.7%，仿真约快200倍；在Llama-2-70B搜索中找到满足300毫秒平均TTFT目标的4卡方案。系统还在仿真中演化并验证控制策略，为低成本、可靠地规划生产级推理部署提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language model (LLM) inference at scale requires jointly selecting hardware layout, parallelism strategy, scheduling policy, admission control, and request routing to meet latency and throughput targets. These choices interact: a routing decision that improves cache locality can concentrate load, and an admission threshold that triggers only at saturation allows queues to grow deep enough to degrade critical-tier traffic. Evaluating candidates on GPU clusters is too expensive for iterative exploration, yet existing predictive tools either ignore batching and queueing dynamics or model only fragments of the pipeline. In this paper, we present BLIS, a deterministic, CPU-only discrete-event simulator that models the full inference serving pipeline (admission, routing, scheduling, prefill/decode execution, KV-cache management, and preemption). BLIS pairs analytical basis functions with learned scaling coefficients and overhead terms, fit once globally, to predict step latency without per-model or per-GPU profiling. Across 36 experiments spanning six models and three GPU types, BLIS achieves 6.7% median end-to-end error while running around 200 times faster than real execution. In a configuration search over 420 serving configurations for Llama-2-70B, BLIS identifies a 4-GPU deployment that meets a 300ms mean TTFT service-level objective (SLO), whereas competing tools either require double the GPUs or recommend configurations that fail under load. Two policies evolved entirely in simulation were validated on real hardware and merged into llm-d, a widely adopted open-source platform for distributed LLM serving: an admission policy that reduces critical-tier TTFT P90 by up to 82%, and a flow-control policy that reduces E2E P50 latency by 32-48% on overloaded workloads.

papers.title_en: A Dependency-Aware Multi-GPU Training Framework for Temporal Graph Neural Networks
papers.authors: Yang Zhao, Yue Dai, Liang Qiao, Buxin Tu, Bo Liu, Sen Zhang, Yi Zhang, Xiaoyu Hao, Jun Shi, Junshi Chen, Hong An
papers.evidence: 面向时序图网络的依赖感知多GPU训练框架
papers.tldr: 时间图神经网络依赖按事件顺序更新节点记忆，现有多GPU训练为保证依赖完整性而频繁同步，限制并行度。DepBloom利用依赖的时间与拓扑局部性，通过时间有界空间划分、批内记忆修复和关键路径优化，减少非必要同步并延后非关键更新。在多模型、多数据集实验中，方案平均加速2.84倍、最高5.16倍，同时保持相当或更优精度。该工作在不牺牲训练质量的前提下提升了TGNN分布式训练效率。
papers.abstract_en: Temporal graph neural networks (TGNNs) achieve superior performance in many dynamic graph learning tasks. These models use node state vectors (i.e., memories) to capture and record graph changes (i.e., events), and then exploit these memories to assist prediction. However, this memory-centric design makes multi-GPU training challenging because predictions for later events often depend on memory updates from earlier events. To maintain model quality, existing multi-GPU TGNN training schemes strictly preserve all event dependencies, which limits parallelism and causes expensive cross-GPU memory synchronization. In this work, we observe that many of these dependencies can be handled more flexibly without harming training quality. Specifically, (a) dependencies in TGNN training have high locality in both time and graph topology, (b) the short-range dependencies missed within a large batch can often be recovered cheaply, and (c) many memory updates are not immediately needed. Based on these observations, we propose DepBloom to accelerate multi-GPU TGNN training with three techniques: (1) temporally bounded spatial partitioning to reduce unnecessary cross-GPU synchronization and improve parallelism; (2) intra-batch memory refinement to recover missing short-range temporal dependencies inside enlarged batches; and (3) critical-path optimization to prioritize urgent memory updates while deferring non-critical work during multi-GPU pipeline execution. Experimental results across representative models and diverse datasets show that DepBloom achieves an average speedup of 2.84$\times$ and up to 5.16$\times$ over state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining comparable or better model accuracy.

papers.title_en: Grounding Deep Learning Framework Testing in Data Flow
papers.authors: Jiatao Ge, Yanzhou Mu, Yinglong Zou, Yibo Hu, Zhenyu Chen, Chunrong Fang
papers.evidence: 面向深度学习框架执行的数据流感知测试
papers.tldr: 深度学习框架的自动微分与算子融合依赖数据流，现有测试主要按算子拓扑建模，难以区分张量值、属性和输入约束不同但拓扑相似的模型。论文提出张量流图，显式刻画运行时张量状态及算子需求，并据此设计变异测试方法FlowMuT。该方法以受约束子图替换生成变异体，结合约束过滤与LinUCB选择候选。实验在PyTorch和MindSpore上发现大量基线遗漏缺陷，证明数据流导向测试能提升多样性、合法率与真实缺陷发现能力。
papers.abstract_en: Data flow underlies deep learning (DL) framework execution, including automatic differentiation and operator-fusion optimization. Bugs involving data flow can cause incorrect results or unexpected behavior. Existing testing methods represent models primarily by operator topology, omitting runtime tensor values and properties and operator input requirements. They therefore cannot distinguish data flows in models with similar topologies, even when these differences affect framework behavior. We introduce the Tensor Flow Graph (TFG) to capture runtime tensor states and operator input requirements. Its nodes represent operators and their input requirements, while its edges record tensor values and properties. Building on the TFG, we propose FlowMuT, a mutation-based testing method grounded in data flow. Mutations are represented as constrained subgraph replacements, with mutation operators derived from prior work and an analysis of mutable data flow objects. In each round, FlowMuT builds a TFG for the seed model, pairs mutation operators with TFG sites, and filters illegal candidates using data flow constraints. It uses LinUCB to select a candidate based on coverage and impact, executes the mutant, updates selection feedback, and uses each accepted mutant as the next seed. We evaluate FlowMuT on PyTorch and MindSpore using representative models from diverse application scenarios. FlowMuT submitted 55 bug reports for cases missed by all baseline methods; developers confirmed 41 reports and fixed the bugs described in 7 reports. FlowMuT achieves 43.4% higher data flow diversity than the strongest baseline and a legal mutant rate of 96.7%, compared with 86.4% without constraints. These results show that testing from a data flow perspective is practical and effective.

papers.title_en: A Production-Grade, High-Efficiency Agentic RL Framework for Frontier LLMs with Validated Recipes
papers.authors: LoonSage Team, Bowei Song, Caiwei Zhao, Chuwen Liu, Dechuang Gu, Dong Fang, Feiyu Xie, Huaiyu Li, Hui Zhang, Jian Tian, Jian Wang, Jie Zhao, Liguang Li, Maoyun Wang, Meiyan Yang, Minghan Zhu, Pai Liu, Pandeng Yao, Renbao Tian, Ru Yang, Shuai Jia, Shuai Tan, Shuailong Li, Shuliang Li, Teng Jin, Tianze Yang, Wenbo Cui, Wenjing Bai, Wenkang Wu, Xiaowei Jiang, Xiaoyi Dong, Yanpeng Wang, Yanwen Wang, Yaohui Ma, Yawen Wang, Yihang Zhang, Yingjie Yan, Zhanbiao Lian, Zhenyu Lu, Zhida Hu, Zhihui Hao, Zhihui Hu, Zhiwen Xiao, Zhiyi Gao, Zhongwei Qi, Zhuangzhuang Wu, Ziqian Liu, Ziyue Zheng
papers.evidence: 基于Megatron的异步大模型分布式强化学习框架
papers.tldr: 前沿大语言模型后训练正转向需调用工具、多轮交互和长程决策的智能体任务，现有强化学习系统却复杂笨重、调试与资源开销高。LoongSage以约1.4万行轻量核心构建智能体原生全异步框架，结合AgentFlow、滑动窗口与拓扑感知权重同步。四项完整训练覆盖复杂强化学习和多教师在线蒸馏，奖励稳定提升且持续控制训推差距。该系统通过消除同步空泡维持硬件利用率，为生产级智能体强化学习提供可验证配方。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a critical phase in the post-training pipeline of large language models (LLMs). As the frontier of LLM capabilities shifts from static reasoning to agentic tasks--characterized by external tool invocation, multi-turn interactions, and long-horizon decision-making--existing mainstream RL frameworks have grown increasingly unwieldy, raising the overhead of adoption, usage, and debugging. To address these challenges, we present LoongSage, an agent-native, fully asynchronous RL framework with a lightweight core of roughly 14K lines of code. Built upon Megatron for distributed training and SGLang for high-throughput inference, LoongSage centralizes orchestration within a single controller process and encapsulates all GPU-resident components as Ray actors. It introduces AgentFlow, a unified execution paradigm that orchestrates both white-box and black-box agents. For asynchronous execution, it integrates sliding-window strategies that bound trajectory staleness, and employs TransferMesh, a topology-aware synchronization mechanism that routes weights after each step over the fastest transport available to each receiver. Beyond agentic RL, LoongSage incorporates a memory-efficient Teacher Manager that decouples the scaling of teacher models from GPU memory constraints, natively supporting Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation. Extensive evaluations across four complete training runs, spanning complex reinforcement learning and multi-teacher distillation, demonstrate that task rewards improve steadily while the train-inference gap is kept under continuous control, and the fully asynchronous pipeline removes synchronous idle bubbles, sustaining hardware utilization.

papers.title_en: Efficient Resource-Shiftable RL Post-training with Generative Rewards
papers.authors: Yanfeng Zhao, Haoyang Li, Sheng Lin, Yuming Zhou, Jiawei Jiang, Bin Cui, Fangcheng Fu
papers.evidence: 面向多阶段大模型后训练的动态GPU资源调度
papers.tldr: 生成式奖励模型驱动的强化学习后训练中，策略生成、奖励评估与训练会动态争抢GPU，静态资源划分易产生闲置。PivotRL构建可迁移运行时，借助全局参数存储与统一上下文迁移机制，在角色间动态调拨资源。其调度器支持序列迁移，规划器综合吞吐收益和迁移开销决定调拨时机。在128卡、覆盖稠密与专家混合模型的实验中，系统保持收敛并显著提升端到端吞吐，证明动态资源重分配可提高RL后训练效率。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training with generative reward models (GenRM) has become a central recipe for improving large language models (LLMs), and it is also increasingly resource-intensive: policy rollout, GenRM-based reward evaluation, and policy training all compete for GPU resources. However, existing colocated and disaggregated systems rely on static resource allocation for these roles. Such allocation cannot adapt as each role's workload changes during RL and therefore leaves a role's resources underutilized.   We present PivotRL, an RL post-training system that dynamically shifts resources among different roles according to their runtime demands. PivotRL introduces a resource-shiftable runtime built on a Global Parameter Storage, together with a unified mechanism that efficiently shifts role-specific context. A shift-aware scheduler enables sequence migration upon a shift, while a planner considers the aggregate throughput benefit and the shift overhead to determine when and how to shift. We evaluate PivotRL on a 128-GPU cluster using four model groups spanning dense and mixture-of-experts models. PivotRL enables resource shifting within seconds and improves end-to-end throughput by 1.81-2.05 times over colocated deployment and 1.50-1.95 times over disaggregated deployment, while preserving RL convergence.

papers.title_en: FlashMask-3: Efficient and Expressive Mask-Aware Distributed Attention
papers.authors: Guoxia Wang, Qianyue He, Siming Wu, Haoyang Xie, Qiwen Bao, Jinle Zeng, Jiabin Yang, Tian Wu, Dianhai Yu
papers.evidence: 面向多节点长上下文训练的分布式注意力内核
papers.tldr: 长上下文大模型训练同时需要处理文档、前缀语言模型等结构化注意力掩码与多节点上下文并行，掩码定位和通信易成瓶颈。FlashMask-3以四个查询轴边界向量线性压缩掩码，并通过零通信定位、稀疏负载均衡和掩码驱动通信裁剪实现分布式执行。其在H100单卡及4至32路上下文并行下显著领先现有方案，并在128卡118B-A14B混合专家训练中提升整体吞吐。工作将高效掩码表示与Hopper专用注意力流水线结合，增强了超长上下文训练的可扩展性。
papers.abstract_en: Long-context training of large language and multimodal models couples structured attention masks (document, prefix-LM, share-question, sliding-window, block-sparse) with multi-node context parallelism, making the mask a dominant bottleneck. FlashMask's column-wise sparse mask compresses them from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n)$ via four query-axis boundary vectors, covering broad structured patterns. Implemented for Ampere GPUs, it neither exploits FlashAttention-3's TMA/WGMMA warp-specialized pipeline on Hopper nor supports distribution. The column-wise sparse mask is indexed by key positions but stores query-axis interval boundaries. Under any multi-chunk context-parallel assignment, it reduces per-rank mask localization to a provably zero-communication \emph{clip--shift--max} on the boundary vectors, compatible with the single-GPU kernel. FlashMask-3 introduces a mask-aware Hopper kernel with three-role warp specialization atop FlashAttention-3's TMA/WGMMA pipeline, plus a mask-aware distributed extension: zero-communication mask localization, a sparsity-aware load balancer (HCC-IPO), and a mask-aware compute-communication overlap with mask-driven communication pruning, whose forward all-gather uses topology-aware hierarchical routing. On a single H100 across 12 masks at 4K--128K context, it improves achieved TFLOPs over FlashMask, FlexAttention, and MagiAttention by 45--141%, 34--71%, and 2--44%. At context-parallel degrees 4--32 with 8K sequence per device, it attains 31--75% compute-communication overlap efficiency and improves throughput over Megatron-Core CP ring, Megatron-Core CP all-gather, and MagiAttention by $1.80\times$--$3.71\times$, $1.71\times$--$2.92\times$, and $1.09\times$--$1.46\times$. In end-to-end training of a 118B-A14B MoE at 128K on 128 H100 GPUs, it raises throughput by 7.3--11.0% over a Dual Chunk all-gather baseline, with attention forward+backward 24.5--44.9% faster.

papers.title_en: NBCLT: Parameter-Agnostic Norm-Ball Clipped Local Training
papers.authors: Linxuan Pan, Shucheng Yang, Junchi Yang
papers.evidence: 面向联邦与去中心化学习的分布式本地训练优化
papers.tldr: 多本地步分布式训练虽能减少通信，却会在数据异质和通信受限条件下放大客户端漂移，并依赖繁琐超参数调节。NBCLT以预测—校正本地更新结合灵活范数球欧氏投影，对更新进行几何约束式裁剪，统一支持联邦与去中心化学习。在适当随训练轮数扩展本地计算预算时，联邦场景无需有界异质性即可达到ε^{-2}通信和ε^{-4}随机梯度复杂度；去中心化静态或时变混合也保持相同精度指数。该框架以较简单实现提供参数无关、可迁移的本地训练方案。
papers.abstract_en: Distributed learning with multiple local steps reduces communication but aggravates drift, and its practical performance often depends on carefully tuned hyperparameters under heterogeneous data and communication constraints. At the same time, recent Muon-type optimizers suggest that constraining updates within suitable norm balls provides a simple way to encode geometric priors into optimization. In this work, we propose NBCLT (Norm-Ball Clipped Local Training), a unified local-training framework for both federated learning (FL) and decentralized learning (DL). NBCLT combines a predict-and-correct local update rule with Euclidean projections onto flexible norm balls, thereby performing norm-ball clipping under flexible update geometries while retaining a simple implementation. In FL, its problem-parameter-free regime achieves $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-2})$ communication complexity and $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-4})$ total stochastic-gradient complexity without assuming bounded heterogeneity, when the per-round local-computation budget is scaled appropriately with the horizon. In DL, NBCLT is compatible with both static and time-varying mixing and preserves these accuracy exponents under the analogous computation scaling, up to fixed network constants and an additive initialization cost.

papers.title_en: A Distributed View from a Single GPU: RankLens for Distributed Training
papers.authors: Yufan Wang, Yihao Zhang, Yi Liu
papers.evidence: 用于分布式训练分析的单GPU仿真系统
papers.tldr: 大规模分布式训练的调试、性能分析与调优通常需要反复在目标规模集群上运行，成本高且门槛大。RankLens让一个幸存进程在单张GPU上执行原始训练代码，并以按任务替换的通信语义模拟其余进程。系统选择性恢复记录的通信结果和完成时序，同时保留异步依赖关系。在DeepSpeed与Megatron-LM的8至64卡实验中，它实现训练张量通信结构100%一致、时序误差低于5%，将多卡分析需求降至单卡。
papers.abstract_en: Modern distributed training is costly to debug, tune, and analyze because faithful analysis often requires repeated target-scale executions. We observe that many analysis tasks depend on the original distributed execution path, but not on full all-rank execution. We present RankLens, a single-rank emulation system that runs one survivor rank on a single GPU while preserving the target job's distributed semantics. The survivor rank executes the original training program and performs real local computation. At communication boundaries, the system replaces real multi-rank communication with task-dependent semantics, selectively restoring recorded communication results and recorded or estimated completion timing while preserving the asynchronous dependencies required for analysis. This enables replay from real executions and supports analysis, debugging, and tuning with existing debuggers and performance analysis tools.   We evaluate the system on DeepSpeed and Megatron-LM across 8-64-GPU target configurations. RankLens achieves 100% training-tensor communication-structure match, keeps emulation timing error below 5%, supports local anomaly reproduction and execution analysis, and reduces the resource requirement of these analyses from target-scale clusters to a single GPU.

papers.title_en: An Optical KV Cache Network for Disaggregated LLM Serving
papers.authors: Seongwon Yoon, Shimeng Yu
papers.evidence: 用于解耦GPU式LLM服务的光互连与预约调度
papers.tldr: 1 分组网络 0.55—0.78 倍成本达到自适应路由 400G 网络性能。工作表明，面向 KV 迁移定制的光网络可低成本改善解耦服务时延。
papers.abstract_en: Disaggregated LLM serving moves each request's KV cache from a prefill GPU to a decode GPU before the response begins, and a coding-agent turn often moves the KV of its whole long context. Behind an oversubscribed packet fabric this transfer adds to time to first token (TTFT). An optical circuit switch (OCS) can give every transfer a full-rate circuit for less than an oversubscribed packet fabric costs, but a mechanical OCS needs tens of milliseconds to reconfigure. We hide this delay inside the prefill. A reservation scheduler commits each circuit while the prefill is still computing, so the circuit is ready when the KV is, and each GPU reaches the OCS over its own wavelength-multiplexed (WDM) optics on one fiber pair. In simulations of GPU clusters on real serving traces with measured prefill times on H100 GPUs, this optical KV cache network matches 400G packet fabrics with adaptive routing at 0.55 to 0.78 times the cost of a 2:1 fabric and tolerates the 50 ms reconfiguration delay of a 384-port mechanical OCS.

papers.title_en: Learning to Sync at the Edge: Client-Side Adaptive Synchronization for Federated Learning
papers.authors: Ebasa Temesgen, Ammar Ahmed, Nathan Lechamo, Ali Anwar, Maria Gini
papers.evidence: 异构联邦训练的自适应同步机制
papers.tldr: 边缘联邦学习中的固定同步策略难以适应客户端算力差异、时变网络与隐私预算，易形成通信和训练瓶颈。论文将同步决策下沉到客户端，以强化学习调度器根据本地训练进展、资源状态和通信条件选择上传、下载、双向同步或暂缓。在交通预测和图像分类任务上，该方法改善了精度—成本权衡：前者降低系统成本，后者在保持竞争性成本下提升最终精度。研究表明，同步应被视为资源感知的客户端自适应控制问题。
papers.abstract_en: The scalability and performance of edge federated learning are fundamentally constrained by synchronization bottlenecks. Clients operate under heterogeneous compute, time-varying communication conditions, and, in some settings, privacy constraints, yet synchronization is often still handled with fixed schedules. However, synchronization decisions are often made outside the client, even though the client directly observes local progress, resource state, and communication conditions. We present a client-side reinforcement learning synchronization framework in which each client decides during training whether to upload, download, synchronize bidirectionally, or defer communication. The framework places a lightweight scheduler alongside the local model and formulates synchronization as a resource-aware control problem driven by local learning and system state. We study this framework on two representative edge workloads, spatiotemporal traffic forecasting and image classification. Across both settings, adaptive client-side synchronization improves the accuracy-cost trade-off, reducing system cost in traffic forecasting while maintaining competitive cost and improving final accuracy in image classification. We also consider privacy-constrained settings, where synchronization must account for not only latency and energy but also privacy expenditure. Overall, our results show that synchronization in edge federated learning is better treated as an adaptive client-side control problem than only as a server-side coordination mechanism.

papers.title_en: Accelerating Cross-Model LLM Inference via Attention Map Reuse
papers.authors: Zhan Jin, Yuze Luo, Bin Cui, Xupeng Miao
papers.evidence: 通过注意力图复用加速跨模型大模型服务
papers.tldr: 在含模式、工具定义与多轮历史的LLM数据工作流中，不同模型常共享长前缀，但KV缓存受架构绑定，难以跨模型复用。MapFlow改为复用更具迁移性的注意力图，并通过部分重算、层头线性翻译、块级稀疏压缩与融合检索实现高效调用。实验表明，该系统在异构模型组合和多轮路由任务中降低预填充延迟、提升端到端服务效率，同时保持生成质量。工作提出注意力图作为跨模型可复用状态，为前缀密集型异构推理提供新路径。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-augmented data workflows often involve multiple heterogeneous models operating over substantial shared context, such as schemas, tool specifications, interaction history, and intermediate results. Although prefix caching can reduce prefilling overhead, existing approaches are largely limited to reuse within the same model because KV states are tightly coupled to model-specific architectures. We present MapFlow, a system for efficient heterogeneous LLM serving via cross-model attention map reuse. Instead of reusing KV states, MapFlow reuses attention maps, which capture token dependency patterns and are more transferable across models. To enable efficient and accurate reuse, we combine partial recomputation with lightweight linear translation across layers and heads. To make attention reuse practical for long contexts, we further introduce block-level sparse compression and a fused retrieval kernel. Experiments show that MapFlow reduces prefilling latency and improves end-to-end serving efficiency while preserving generation quality across heterogeneous model pairs and multi-turn routing workloads. These results suggest that attention maps provide an effective reusable state for heterogeneous LLM serving, especially in prefix-heavy data workflows. Our code is available: https://github.com/PKU-DAIR/MapFlow.

papers.title_en: AgentWeave: Efficient Distributed Agent Serving via Flow Decomposition
papers.authors: Kaibin Guo, Pengtu Li, Zicong Hong, Zhiyuan Fang, Wuhui Chen, Rachid Guerraoui, Anne-Marie Kermarrec
papers.evidence: 具备流水线均衡能力的分布式大模型智能体服务架构
papers.tldr: 智能体应用由大模型调用与工具调用构成多模块工作流，现有分离式部署虽能流水并行，却因模块时延失衡产生流水线气泡；聚合式部署消除气泡，又会让短请求与新请求被长流程批次阻塞。AgentWeave在聚合架构上提出流分解，将长请求拆成保持语义的细粒度执行单元，并以流自适应调度权衡吞吐收益与调度开销。四类应用实验显示，其相对先进基线吞吐提升1.81倍，平均延迟和P90延迟分别降低2.45倍、2.04倍，为高效分布式智能体服务提供方案。
papers.abstract_en: Agent applications are evolving into workflows composed of large language model (LLM) calls and tool invocations, termed modules. Existing distributed agent systems typically adopt a disaggregated architecture, deploying different modules on separate devices. While this enables pipeline parallelism, imbalanced module latencies introduce severe pipeline bubbles that limit throughput. A natural alternative is an aggregated architecture that co-deploys all modules across all devices, eliminating bubbles by keeping every device continuously active. However, this introduces request blocking: short requests are forced to progress in lockstep with longer ones in the same batch, and newly arriving requests must wait until the entire ongoing batch completes the full workflow. To address this, we propose AgentWeave, an efficient distributed serving system for agent applications built on the aggregated architecture. Its core mechanism, flow decomposition, decomposes long agent requests into fine-grained execution units while preserving agent semantics, allowing short and newly arriving requests to proceed without being stalled by long-running ones. Complementing this, a flow-adaptive scheduler dynamically balances the throughput gains of decomposition against its scheduling overhead. Experiments across four representative agent applications demonstrate that AgentWeave improves throughput by 1.81x, reduces average latency by 2.45x, and reduces P90 latency by 2.04x over state-of-the-art baselines.

papers.title_en: Compositional Performance Modeling of LLM Inference Clusters with Hierarchical KV Caching
papers.authors: Ruiyang Ma, Sheng Qi, DaiKang Kuang, Teng Ma, Guojie Luo
papers.evidence: 面向LLM推理集群的性能建模与设计空间探索
papers.tldr: 大模型推理集群的设计空间探索难以仅凭单机算子画像预测端到端延迟，因为分层KV缓存复用会改变计算需求，缓存位置、容量与争用还会重塑执行顺序。论文提出组合式离散事件模拟器，将本地服务成本与共享资源、KV可用性分离建模，并复用1P-1D标定模型比较不同策略和拓扑。在Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B及1P-1D、3P-1D集群上，问答与编码会话延迟误差分别为1.34%和6.36%。该框架可快速评估会话亲和与缓存保留策略对计算、时延和KV占用的联合影响。
papers.abstract_en: Design-space exploration of LLM inference clusters requires predicting how hardware and serving policies interact with hierarchical key-value (KV) caching. Isolated operation profiles alone do not determine cluster latency: reuse changes computational demand, while KV location, capacity, and contention govern execution order. We present a compositional discrete-event simulator based on separating local service costs from shared resource and KV availability. Compute and transfer models calibrated on one-prefill/one-decode (1P-1D) deployments are reused across compatible workers, enabling policy and topology comparisons without per-configuration latency fitting. Validation against SGLang covers Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B on 1P-1D and 3P-1D clusters. Mean request end-to-end latency error is 1.34% for question answering and 6.36% for captured coding sessions, measured as mean absolute percentage error. CPU simulation reduces replay turnaround by 15.33 times on average; real replay includes prescribed arrival gaps. Measured session-affinity and simulated retention studies demonstrate how the framework guides policy selection by predicting the joint effects on computation, latency, and KV occupancy.

papers.title_en: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
papers.authors: Xin Wang, Hao Yu, Zhengyang Zhuge, Bochao Mao, Zheng Li, Junda Feng, Yuyan Luo, Yi Zhang, Yizhong Cao, Mi Zhang, Dayiheng Liu, Jianwei Zhang
papers.evidence: 通过FP4量化降低MoE大模型强化学习训练成本
papers.tldr: 大模型强化学习的轨迹生成计算与显存开销高，因而需要低精度推理；但现有FP4方法分别优化训练和生成路径，二者量化误差失配会损害策略学习。TRACE以生成侧量化结果指导训练侧FP4舍入，并缓存深层关键量化信息以控制额外通信与存储。它在多类MoE模型及推理、代码和长程任务中实现接近BF16生成的强化学习效果，轨迹生成最高加速5.4倍，证明训练—生成量化对齐可支撑高效端到端FP4强化学习。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for post-training large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial computation and memory overhead during rollout generation, which motivates low-precision rollout for efficient RL training. However, existing FP4 RL methods suffer from a key limitation: they primarily optimize quantization accuracy on the training and rollout paths independently rather than directly reducing the discrepancy between the two quantized execution paths. In this work, we propose TRACE (Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE), an FP4 quantization framework for RL training of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models that addresses the limitation of existing FP4 RL methods. TRACE incorporates rollout-guided quantization-aware training that uses rollout-side quantization outcomes to guide training-side FP4 rounding decisions, directly reducing train-rollout discrepancy. Moreover, TRACE adopts an efficient quantization-information caching scheme that selectively retains mantissa and scale information from deeper layers to reduce the storage and communication overhead introduced by rollout guidance. We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4xrollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.

papers.title_en: ORDERS: An Empirical Study of Norm-Rank Aggregation for Personalized Federated Learning
papers.authors: Koffka Khan
papers.evidence: 采用服务端更新聚合的联邦优化方法
papers.tldr: 个性化联邦学习中，服务器聚合权重的作用常被本地训练与评测设置混淆。ORDERS将共享骨干、私有残差适配器与分类器结合，并按客户端更新范数降序赋予几何权重，同时加入特征对齐和私有参数扰动。在双类客户端CIFAR-10上，其原生平均准确率为80.51%，略高于匹配的均匀加权对照80.27%。研究表明范数排序的独立增益有限，严格对照与端点相关消融对评估聚合规则尤为重要。
papers.abstract_en: Personalized federated learning combines shared representations with client-specific predictors, but the contribution of a server weighting rule can be obscured by local training and evaluation choices. We study ORDERS, a configuration that combines a shared backbone, a private residual adapter and classifier, geometric weights assigned by descending update norm, feature alignment, and private-parameter perturbations. The server computes a weighted sum of updates obtained from the same broadcast model; it does not obtain an additional optimization effect from sequential addition. A fully specified evaluation comprises 80 final runs: eight configurations, two datasets, and five training seeds on one fixed partition per dataset. On two-class-per-client CIFAR-10, ORDERS achieves $80.51 \pm 0.79\%$ native mean client accuracy, compared with $79.02 \pm 1.42\%$ for FedPer-R1 and $80.27 \pm 0.73\%$ for the matched uniform-weight control. After common local fine-tuning, the difference from FedPer-R1 narrows to 0.32 percentage points. On Sent140, ORDERS reaches $74.71 \pm 0.49\%$, only 0.69 points above a post hoc client training-majority diagnostic. Ablations provide limited, endpoint-dependent evidence for norm ranking and alignment, and no clear benefit from perturbations. Parameter-payload savings are 5.47% and 0.78%, respectively.

papers.title_en: Federated Zeroth-Order Optimization with Direction Aggregation and Variance Reduction
papers.authors: Qianlong Dang, Baosheng Li
papers.evidence: 采用聚合机制的联邦分布式优化
papers.tldr: 面向联邦场景中的受约束、非光滑非凸随机黑盒优化，现有方法依赖本地零阶更新与模型平均，易受客户端漂移及估计采样方差影响。论文提出以方向聚合替代模型聚合的联邦零阶框架，并设计FedZOO与FedVRZO两种本地采样机制。前者通过共享小批量控制数据与方向估计误差，后者以独立样本—方向对直接控制方差。理论上分别给出收敛保证，黑盒对抗攻击实验验证了方法有效性。
papers.abstract_en: We study constrained nonsmooth nonconvex stochastic optimization in federated settings, where clients access only stochastic function evaluations. Existing federated zeroth-order methods primarily combine local zeroth-order updates with model averaging. However, they struggle with client drift induced by local projected updates and sampling variance in stochastic zeroth-order estimates. In this paper, we propose a federated zeroth-order framework based on direction aggregation, equipped with two local sampling schemes. Specifically, FedZOO constructs a local direction from a minibatch shared across multiple spherical queries, thereby controlling the stochastic errors arising from data sampling and gradient approximation. In contrast, FedVRZO forms its local estimator from independent sample--direction pairs, so that its sampling error is controlled directly by the number of sample--direction pairs. In both algorithms, clients compute the mean of the directions evaluated along their projected local trajectories, and the server performs a single projected update using the weighted aggregate of the client directions. Furthermore, we establish convergence guarantees for FedZOO and FedVRZO, respectively. Experiments on black-box adversarial attacks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

papers.title_en: Batch Before You Lift: Scalable Topological Deep Learning on Large Graphs
papers.authors: David Leko, Luka Benić, Guillermo Bernárdez, Nina Miolane, Olga Fink, Lev Telyatnikov
papers.evidence: 避免完整图提升物化的可扩展训练框架
papers.tldr: 拓扑深度学习需先将普通图提升为超图、胞腔或单纯复形，但大图的全局提升和存储会造成难以承受的计算与显存开销。Cluster-TNN先对输入图分区，训练时采样簇组、重建诱导子图，并在批内即时执行提升。该方法保留采样节点间全部边，以构造跨簇高阶结构。它在21组对比中平均降低83.2%峰值显存且性能具竞争力，使Reddit和OGBN Products等大规模数据上的多种高阶模型训练首次可行。
papers.abstract_en: Topological Deep Learning extends graph-based learning to higher-order domains, such as hypergraphs, cellular, and simplicial complexes. These domains are typically constructed from patterns in an input graph through a process of graph lifting. Full-domain training constructs and stores the complete lifted representation before model execution. On large and dense datasets like Reddit (233k nodes and 57.3M edges), this global materialization becomes a severe computational bottleneck, often rendering training infeasible. To address this limitation, we introduce Cluster-TNN, a domain-agnostic framework that avoids this bottleneck by lifting locally instead. After partitioning the input graph during preprocessing, at runtime Cluster-TNN dynamically samples groups of node clusters, reconstructs their induced subgraphs to form mini-batches, and applies the chosen lifting within each mini-batch. Retaining all edges among sampled nodes preserves the connectivity needed to construct higher-order structures across clusters, producing topological mini-batches that existing Topological Neural Networks can process directly. Across 21 matched comparisons with full-graph execution, Cluster-TNN reduces peak GPU memory in every configuration, by 83.2% on average while maintaining competitive predictive performance. Notably, such a reduction enables, to our knowledge, the first training of multiple different higher-order Topological Neural Networks on large datasets such as Reddit and OGBN Products. These results establish Cluster-TNN as a general strategy for scaling Topological Deep Learning beyond the limitations of global domain construction.

papers.title_en: PLADOS: A Parameter-free Landing Algorithm for Decentralized Optimization on the Stiefel Manifold
papers.authors: Shu Li, Jiang Hu
papers.evidence: 通信图上的去中心化随机优化
papers.tldr: 去中心化Stiefel流形优化广泛用于机器学习与信号处理，但现有方法常依赖回缩操作和需调参的惩罚或通信机制，面对节点异质性时效率与稳定性受限。PLADOS将本地随机梯度与一次免回缩通信结合，并借助受限割线不等式刻画流形约束和一致性约束交集的局部收缩。理论上，它以无额外参数的方式获得随节点数线性加速的收敛保证；实验显示其对步长和网络更稳定且更省时，为分布式正交约束学习提供实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized optimization on the Stiefel manifold has broad applications in machine learning and signal processing. We propose PLADOS, a parameter-free landing algorithm for decentralized optimization on the Stiefel manifold. Each iteration combines local stochastic gradient updates with a single retraction-free communication step over the communication graph. A key convex-like property of the intersection of the nonconvex Stiefel manifold and consensus constraints is characterized through a restricted secant inequality for the penalty-only scheme, ensuring local contraction of the manifold consensus error without introducing additional parameters that require tuning. For $n$ nodes using independent local batches of size $b$, we prove that PLADOS achieves linear speedup with respect to the number of nodes with an asymptotic convergence rate of $O(σ/\sqrt{nbK}+(nξ^2)^{1/3}/K^{2/3})$ after $K$ iterations, where $σ^2>0$ is the sampling variance and $ξ^2$ quantifies gradient heterogeneity. Experiments demonstrate stability across tested stepsizes and networks, time efficiency, and linear speedup with respect to the number of nodes.

papers.title_en: Perspective: Content-addressable memories as a computing primitive for today's AI and beyond
papers.authors: Paul-Philipp Manea, Bo Wen, Peiyi He, Can Li, John Paul Strachan
papers.evidence: 面向检索密集AI负载的硬件架构
papers.tldr: 当前AI硬件主要围绕稠密线性代数优化，但注意力、树模型推理和基因组检索等任务需要按内容或相似度访问数据，传统存储支持不足。本文提出将内容可寻址存储器作为关联计算原语，利用其阵列内大规模并行匹配能力执行检索。文章归纳新型存储器提升密度与能效的潜力，并讨论分层搜索、专用架构、硬件感知学习及与存内计算异构集成。其意义在于推动“关联检索+线性代数”共同构成未来AI硬件基础。
papers.abstract_en: Modern artificial intelligence is predominantly executed on computing architectures optimized for dense linear algebra. While this has enabled the success of contemporary neural networks and motivated compute-in-memory (CIM) architectures, a growing class of artificial intelligence (AI) workloads depends on associative retrieval, identifying stored information by content or similarity rather than by explicit memory addresses. Such operations are central to transformer attention, tree-based inference, genomic search, and other retrieval-intensive applications, yet remain inefficiently supported by conventional memory systems. In this Perspective, we argue that content-addressable memories (CAMs) provide a complementary hardware primitive for associative processing in AI. We review their ability to perform massively parallel in-memory matching, discuss how emerging memory technologies can improve density and energy efficiency, and identify hierarchical search, application-specific architectures, hardware-aware learning, and heterogeneous integration with CIM as key directions for scalable associative computing. Together, these developments suggest that associative retrieval should complement linear algebra as a foundational computing primitive for future AI systems.

papers.title_en: RealtimeWAM: How Fast Can I Run My World Action Model?
papers.authors: Huanan Liu, Ye Li, Kangye Ji, Xiaoyu Chen, Hanyun Cui, Yutian Shen, Yuan Meng, Chenglei Wu, Jingyan Jiang, Bo Li, Zhi Wang
papers.evidence: 面向低延迟机器学习推理的自适应并行执行
papers.tldr: 世界动作模型需同时理解视觉动态并生成动作，但未来预测与闭环推理带来较高延迟，难以支撑灵敏机器人控制。RealtimeWAM提出无需训练的通用加速框架，按层依赖并行观测处理和预测，并以视觉稳定区特征缓存、Transformer残差复用及小调整精炼自适应分配算力。在RTX 4090上，它将FastWAM和OpenWAM平均延迟降至24.09与63.09毫秒，提速8.90倍与10.67倍，仿真成功率几乎不降。该方法跨架构兼顾低时延和控制性能，并提升真实任务表现。
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) combine visual dynamics modeling with action generation, but their high inference latency limits responsive robot control. Recent efforts accelerate inference by removing explicit future-video generation at test time, as in FastWAM, an approach that requires a specially tailored architectural design. More general caching strategies exploit feature redundancy, but redundancy alone does not capture the changing computational demands of closed-loop control. To address these challenges, we present RealtimeWAM, a general, training-free framework that coordinates parallel execution with adaptive computation for low-latency inference across diverse WAM architectures. We exploit layerwise dependencies to overlap observation processing with prediction. However, concurrent branches still compete for GPU resources, limiting the benefit of parallel execution. We therefore adapt computation throughout the pipeline through selective reuse, caching observation features in visually stable regions and reusing Transformer residuals while reserving additional refinement for small predicted adjustments. We evaluate RealtimeWAM on FastWAM and OpenWAM across RoboTwin, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus. On an RTX 4090, measured mean inference latencies are 24.09 and 63.09 ms, corresponding to average speedups of 8.90$\times$ and 10.67$\times$. Average success rates are 82.75% and 87.41%, respectively, within 0.02 and 0.53 percentage points of native inference. Across five real-world tasks, RealtimeWAM improves average success rates over native inference by 17.2 and 37.2 percentage points on FastWAM and OpenWAM, respectively.
